rationale: Underlined text tab menu whose panels each render a 3-column grid of linked article cards (image, tag, H3, short description).
visualCharacteristics.purpose: tab menu whose panels each render a grid of linked article cards

contentPattern.description: Interactive tab component; each panel's article cards stay inside the tab panel (blocks cannot nest). All four tab labels and every card image are kept. Tabs: Climbing, Water, Cycling, Hiking. Each panel cell holds 3 items: image, tag paragraph, H3 title (link to article), description.
contentPattern.structure: one row per tab: cell 1 tab label; cell 2 repeated cards, each authored as image, tag paragraph, H3 heading containing the article link, short description

cells: Tab content: repeated [image, tag, H3 with link, description]

usage: Use to group article cards by category behind tabs (e.g. Climbing, Water, Cycling, Hiking).
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any tabbed card grid. A new card starts at each image (or each heading when a card has no image).
